notes.title: 3.8.2 Update
notes.content: - Fixed bug where the player was given the 'Hardcore Completion' achievement while completing on Normal Difficulty

notes.title: 3.8.1 Update
notes.content: - Increased closet amount when playing in Normal difficulty

notes.title: Update 3.7.0
notes.content:
- Added minimap that indicates pills and closets
- Increased flashlight strength
- Removed feature where the player is not allowed to move when using up stamina
- Other Improvements

notes.title: Small Update 3.6.9
notes.content:
- Closest hiding spots are visible through walls when being chased
- Fixed bug where the player would get caught despite hiding
- Improved controller support
- Other Improvements

notes.title: 3.6.8 Update Notes
notes.content:
- Added Master Volume slider in Settings
- Fixed Controller bugs
- Minor Improvements
